findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "image_upload" stacks urgency/override words (never, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: site_check, diff, fetch, robots, redirects, image_upload, kv, file, code, domainrisk · Private data: email_verify, dns, markdown, token, wallet, github_tree, sec, kv, file, code, email_send · Public sink: email_verify, site_check, image_upload, kv, file, code, email_send, domainrisk · Destructive: image_upload, image_info, kv, file, code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: site_check, diff, fetch, robots, redirects, image_upload, kv, file, code, domainrisk · Private data: email_verify, dns, markdown, token, wallet, github_tree, sec, kv, file, code, email_send · Public sink: email_verify, site_check, image_upload, kv, file, code, email_send, domainrisk · Destructive: image_upload, image_info, kv, file, code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "onchain" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Daily cleaned on-chain activity snapshot for Ethereum and Base: latest block heights and simple activity proxies. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402)." → after: "Ethereum and Base right now: latest block, average block time, transactions per block, how full blocks are, next base fee and typical priority fee (gwei). Refreshed about every 30 minutes; taken offline (not sold) if it ever goes 2 hours without a good update. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successf"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
